name: Leclerc
protection: Modular composite armour, XLR adds side/rear protection kits and slat. Game: immune to all small arms incl. 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm on frontal arc; only launchers (Javelin, top-attack) or tank guns kill it; tandem-HEAT launchers (AT4 HEDP no, RPG-7 PG-7V only to sides/rear) can disable tracks, optics and side hull.
visual_notes: Low angular turret with flat sides and a long rear bustle holding the autoloader
6 road wheels per side, side skirts with bolted armour modules
3-man crew: no loader hatch; commander's panoramic sight on a raised pedestal
XLR: slat cages on rear hull, remote weapon station on the roof, new side panels
Gun with thermal sleeve and muzzle reference sensor
